あらすじ

The protagonist was stalking a female student that caught his interest. That was when Shijou Megumi, a teacher, intervened. Hoping to put the stalking to a stop, she suggested take her place, under the condition that the stalking stopped.

item.description:

  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アンタなんて大嫌い！～いたぶられる女学生～
  • 英語名: Anta Nante Daikirai! Itaburareru Jogakusei

あらすじ

This is the revenge story of an otaku who was rejected by Mahiro, the girl he loved.

After confessing to Mahiro, he suddenly became the school’s laughingstock. Upon eavesdropping on one of her conversations, he finds out that she was the one who spread the word all over school.

Feeling an overwhelming sense of betrayal, he decided to take revenge. When it was time to go home, the protagonist put his plan into motion and forcefully confined her in his room.

Main character used to direct AV films, but was overwhelmed with this industry and quit. But as he runs out of money, he returns to the idea of filming such movie again with a weak-willed actress. 别名

  • 責められて～バージンレディ～

あらすじ

The protagonist, who woke up late and was in a hurry to get to his part time job, was stopped for questioning by the policewoman Aoshima Haruka.

After knowing that the protagonist is a mere part-timer, he was humiliated and treated as a criminal, and was interrogated with a barrage of questions, but he somehow managed to endure it.
